features: Single Socket BR (LGA-7529) Intel® Xeon® 6900 series processors with P-cores up to 500W with air cooling
Up to 12 DIMMs supporting up to 3TB MRDIMM 8800 in 1DPC
Flexible networking with up to 2 PCIe 5.0 x16 FH AOC + 1 optional AIOM slot
Up to 2 PCIe 5.0 x16 FH10.5"L slots (1x double-width GPU or 2x single-width AOCs)
GrandTwin front IO module offers additional value for networking expansion(10G/25G/200G).
2 Redundant 2200W Titanium (certification pending) Level power supplies

CPU: Intel® Xeon® 6900 series processors with P-cores
Note: Supports up to 500W TDP CPUs (Air Cooled)

Max GPU Count: Up to 1 double-width or 2 single-width GPUs

Memory: Max Memory (1DPC): Up to 3TB 8800MT/s ECC DDR5 MRDIMM
Max Memory (1DPC): Up to 3TB 6400MT/s ECC DDR5 RDIMM

NVMe: NVMe; RAID 0/1/5/10 support(VROC HW key required)

Hardware: Silicon Root of Trust (RoT) – NIST 800-193 Compliant

PCI-Express (PCIe) Configuration: Default 2 PCIe 5.0 x16 (in x16) FH/10.5"L slots
CXL Support: Up to 64 internal CXL 2.0 x16 Type 1/Type 2/Type 3 devices
M.2: 2 M.2 PCIe 5.0 x4 NVMe slots (M-key 22110(default); VROC required for RAID)

Drive Bays Configuration: Default: Total 4 bays 4 front hot-swap 2.5" PCIe 5.0 x4 NVMe drive bays
M.2: 2 M.2 PCIe 5.0 x4 NVMe slots (M-key 22110(default)/2280; VROC required for RAID)
